SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN (((RTRIM(r."STATUS") = 'PENDING') OR (RTRIM(r."STATUS") = 'RETRY')) AND (r."ATTEMPTS" < :p_max_attempts)) THEN (0 + 1) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "VALUE"
FROM :rows AS r
WHERE ((RTRIM(r."COMPANY") = RTRIM(:p_company)) AND (RTRIM(r."CHANNEL") = RTRIM(:p_channel)))
hana:
PROCEDURE "enterprise::EVENT_BACKLOG" (
  IN rows TABLE ("COMPANY" NVARCHAR(4), "CHANNEL" NVARCHAR(20), "STATUS" NVARCHAR(12), "ATTEMPTS" BIGINT),
  IN p_company NVARCHAR(255),
  IN p_channel NVARCHAR(255),
  IN p_max_attempts BIGINT,
  OUT result BIGINT
)
LANGUAGE SQLSCRIPT
SQL SECURITY INVOKER
READS SQL DATA
AS
BEGIN
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN (((RTRIM(r."STATUS") = 'PENDING') OR (RTRIM(r."STATUS") = 'RETRY')) AND (r."ATTEMPTS" < :p_max_attempts)) THEN (0 + 1) ELSE 0 END), 0) INTO result
FROM :rows AS r
WHERE ((RTRIM(r."COMPANY") = RTRIM(:p_company)) AND (RTRIM(r."CHANNEL") = RTRIM(:p_channel)));
END;

semantics.characterComparison: RTRIM preserves ABAP fixed-character trailing-space comparison
semantics.numericBoundary: Source inputs and every intermediate arithmetic value must fit signed ABAP 32-bit integers; target BIGINT extends capacity only after separate qualification
